answer: Require each agent identity to carry a sequential chain of compute-hard proofs, each link costing a fixed minimum of real CPU time to forge. An attacker creating fake identities faces linear cost: ten thousand hollow accounts demand ten thousand times the compute, so a Sybil swarm cannot be conjured from thin air. Honest agents only trust peers with unbroken chains stretching across epochs; a newcomer that chatters like a raven but shows no chained work earns nothing, while proven identities can spend their earned copper on real transactions.
